agreement_scope_raw.value: Business, Social Sciences, Art & Design & Masscom

min_standing_note.value: Must be enrolled at a partner institution and meet department-specific prerequisites/portfolios where required.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel scope lists majors/disciplines ('Business, Social Sciences, Art & Design & Masscom') rather than an AUC school code.

eligible_majors.notes: Parsed directly from Excel scope 'Business, Social Sciences, Art & Design & Masscom'.

excluded_majors.notes: Exchange limited to the four contracted subject areas in the AUC agreement.

min_gpa_host.notes: OsloMet waives strict institutional GPA cutoffs for exchange nominees vetted by their home university ('C' ECTS average applies to regular degree admissions, not bilateral exchange).

english_course_availability.notes: Wide English-taught exchange offerings across Business, Social Sciences, Art & Design, and Journalism/Media.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Non-native English speakers outside specific European partnership waivers must submit TOEFL iBT >=80, IELTS Academic >=6.0 (min 6.0 each band), or PTE Academic.

host_language_requirement.value: None required for English-taught exchange modules.

fall_term_dates.value: Autumn Semester runs approximately August through December (exact academic calendar dates not retrieved verbatim in search_web).

spring_term_dates.value: Spring Semester runs approximately January through June (exact academic calendar dates not retrieved verbatim in search_web).

tuition_model.notes: Note: Tuition exemption statement in search summary lacked a direct [oslomet.no] inline tag and Norwegian exchange fee-waiver URL was not directly verified as a citation; left unknown (SiO NOK semester-fee exemption IS verified at /student/semester-fee).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Official oslomet.no monthly student budget estimate: NOK 13,000-16,500/month covering housing, groceries, public transport, books, and personal costs.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly NOK range 13,000-16,500 (midpoint 14,750.0)/month. ECB cross-rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD and 1 EUR = 10.5695 NOK -> 1 NOK = 0.104565 USD (2026-11-13, retrieved 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html); 5-month USD est = 14,750.0 NOK * 5 * 0.104565 = 7,711.67 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Incoming exchange students are officially EXEMPT from OsloMet's SiO semester fee (semesteravgift); optional SAIH donations or course material fees may apply.

housing_availability.notes: Housing in Oslo arranged via SiO (Student Welfare Organisation in Oslo and Akershus) or alternatives; standard SiO priority housing windows typically close Jun 1 (Autumn) and Nov 1 (Spring).

housing_notes.value: Apply early via SiO housing portal per guidance on oslomet.no/en/student/accommodation-international-students.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: No incoming exchange stipend published on oslomet.no.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA students require a Norwegian Study Permit (UDI) and must document financial funds per UDI thresholds; refer to OsloMet finance/UDI links.

english_course_list_url.notes: No static English-only exchange course list URL observed on oslomet.no.

credit_system_and_load.notes: Norwegian ECTS system standard, though exact exchange credit load limits were not verified directly on an oslomet.no page.

course_restrictions_note.value: Some departments/art & design courses enforce prerequisites or portfolio reviews; AUC agreement limits intake to Business, Social Sciences, Art & Design, and Mass Communication.

academic_style.notes: Applied metropolitan university structure across two campuses; pedagogical style details unverified on oslomet.no.

city_tier.notes: Located in Oslo, Norway (plus Kjeller campus 20 km outside); oslomet.no excerpts do not cite explicit population tier figures.

campus_type.notes: OsloMet explicitly operates two campuses: Campus Pilestredet (central Oslo) and Campus Kjeller (~20 km outside Oslo near Lillestrøm).

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: Not explicitly rated on verified oslomet.no pages.

international_support_services.value: Exchange admissions & partner support, English-requirement guidance, and SiO student welfare/housing access (with semester-fee exemption for exchange students).

nomination_deadlines.value: Autumn semester: Nomination Apr 1, Application Apr 15. Spring semester: Nomination Sep 23, Application Oct 1-5.
